application.name: FreeCAD Local
application.original_official_application_final_read: Historical observation before the separately authorized system app replacement; no claim of current original-path preservation.
application.previous_application_backup_scope: Saved previous source launcher bundle. Its shell wrapper launches this same repository build/release/bin/FreeCAD, which this task rebuilt; the saved bundle is not a frozen copy of older compiled runtime binaries.

dependencies.configuration: Existing reviewed Qt package selection and imported targets were verified; Qt was not rebuilt.
dependencies.supported_entrypoints: Open /Applications/FreeCAD-27.1.0.app or use freecad-local/freecadcmd-local. Native wrappers resolve current app libraries before the fixed Pixi prefix. Raw Contents/Resources/bin executables retain original absolute RPATHs and are not supported standalone entrypoints.

evidence.format: gzip-compressed JSON of allowlisted base64 file bytes with size and SHA-256; initial-stage evidence is a verbatim nested gzip JSON archive

reference_resolution.historical source_path values: Physical paths at the recorded stage; initial installed app paths are no longer current after the authorized move.
reference_resolution.initial-stage/ and final-stage/ referenc: Member paths in this final evidence archive.
reference_resolution.task/ and other inherited build or valid: Member paths within the decoded nested initial-stage/macarm-local-installation-evidence.json.gz archive. These are frozen initial-stage evidence, not top-level final-stage paths.

final.user_authorization: User explicitly authorized replacing /Applications/FreeCAD-27.1.0.app with this verified build.

limits.purpose: Build, install and verify this source revision on this host; this does not replace retained broader qualification evidence.
limits.signing: Local ad-hoc signature; no notarized distribution was produced.

receipt_recording_commit.meaning: The later commit recording this receipt is not the source commit compiled in the installed binary.

scope: Host-local Apple Silicon Release source installation, followed by user-authorized replacement at the existing system app path

validation.initial_functional_checks_reused_after_m: Passed native fixtures, Draft regressions, modeling/FCStd/STEP and GUI render/TechDraw export remain initial-stage results. Final executable and core library hashes match that verified build; no suite or build was rerun for relocation.

resolved_findings.actual_regression_test: Root will exercise installed CLI with nonexistent explicit directories. Not run by reviewer.
resolved_findings.fix_verified: set_default_directory now returns mkdir_parents(existing) for a nonempty explicit variable; value remains unchanged and invalid paths fail before exec.
resolved_findings.problem: Explicit nonexistent FREECAD_USER_HOME/DATA/TEMP directories were preserved but not created, allowing FreeCAD to discard them and fall back to default profiles.

resolved_findings.actual_regression_test: Root finish-app-fixed-result.json records the finishing retry; reviewer did not execute it.
resolved_findings.fix_verified: Helper resolves macOS SDK with xcrun, preflights SDK usr/include/errno.h, and passes that exact SDK with -isysroot to both arm64 launcher compilations.
resolved_findings.problem: Apple Clang compile lacked a selected macOS SDK, producing missing errno.h.

validation.origins: Installed native core/workbench modules and pinned external Python/Qt paths were checked in CLI, Draft and GUI runs.
